```powershell
Write-Output '=== OMNI GROUNDING FIX (Tyree 2026-10-27 22:49 MDT: "Fix it all" — the DONE bar in his words: two fully rendered, fully interactive games, not two shadows falling in a sky or blue void. Measured disease from his PIE screens: OMNIWorld tall actors=115, floaters=51, bases 235.9-1420.5, pawn hanging in blue beside the floating ring, clock true, map check 0 errors, same 3 palette warnings. This job, in one run: censuses floaters BEFORE, snaps every tall floater (height >= 150, base > 50) down so its base sits at z=0 keeping its x/y, lays a PHI_GROUND slab (engine cube, M_PHI_DeepBlue) with its top at z=0 spanning the district, sets PlayerStart z=120 above the slab keeping its x/y, places a NavMeshBoundsVolume if none exists (bake NOT claimed), sets the Nanite usage flag on the three PHI palette materials, saves the level, censuses AFTER. Waits up to ~3 minutes for the Unreal Editor to close first — a commandlet must never fight the open editor for the map file; if the editor is still open after the wait, it reports and stops, nothing touched.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 13) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after ~3 min - fix deferred, nothing touched. Close the OMNI editor and this job gets refiled.'; Write-Output 'OMNI GROUNDING FIX DEFERRED'; return }
$b64 = ''
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes('D:\_PhiHolding\groundfix302.py', [Convert]::FromBase64String($b64))
$uproj = Get-ChildItem 'D:\OMNI-UE' -Filter '*.uproject' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
$cmd = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $cmd)) { $cmd = Get-ChildItem 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games' -Recurse -Filter 'UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName }
if ($uproj -and $cmd) {
  $log = 'D:\OMNI-UE\Saved\groundfix302.py.log'
  $p = Start-Process $cmd -ArgumentList @($uproj, '-run=pythonscript', '-script=D:\_PhiHolding\groundfix302.py', "-abslog=$log", '-nullrhi', '-unattended') -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden
  "commandlet exit: $($p.ExitCode)" | Write-Output
  if (Test-Path $log) { Select-String -Path $log -Pattern 'PHI FIX|Error|Traceback|Exception' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO LOG PRODUCED' }
} else { Write-Output 'TERRAIN MISSING: uproject or editor-cmd not found - nothing ran' }
Write-Output 'OMNI GROUNDING FIX DONE'
```
